name: frontend
description: Frontend work on the TypeScript and React stack: the frontend-engineering router (the stack router of design and apply), React and frontend patterns, TypeScript, Zod and Tailwind CSS 4, production-grade UI design on the project's own tokens, component tests with Testing Library and end-to-end tests with Playwright, a TypeScript reviewer, the Node dependency scan of verify, and accessibility audits against WCAG 2.2 A and AA with the accessibility_review gate.
